name: Juvenile Disc Disorder / Adolescent Disc Degeneration
tags: juvenile disc disorder / adolescent disc degeneration
definition: Symptomatic intervertebral disc degeneration or endplate-related disc disorder in adolescents, sometimes associated with back pain and early degenerative changes.

investigations.principle: MRI is used when persistent symptoms or red flags justify imaging.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, physeal, occult injury, deformity or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Imaging abnormalities should be correlated carefully because some disc changes are incidental.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Kati-shoola phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Symptomatic intervertebral disc degeneration or endplate-related disc disorder in adolescents, sometimes associated with back pain and early degenerative changes.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, open injury, severe deformity, rapidly progressive neurological symptoms, suspected infection or other listed red flags.
